title: Figma components export
description: Each library component's Figma component in the Rove Design System file: its name, node id and variant properties. Exported from Figma by pnpm figma:export, never edited by hand: a component's Figma name is its code name in sentence case unless figma-differences.json gives another. checks/figma-export.ts fails when Figma has changed since, and pnpm gen merges each entry into components.gen.json and compares its variants with the props.

figmaFileUrl.description: The Rove Design System file's URL, which the export read. Its file key is the part after /design/.

components.description: Every library component that has a Figma component, by its export name. Parts drawn inside their family's component share its node.

figmaName.description: The component's (or component set's) name in Figma, exactly.

figmaNodeId.description: The node id of the component or component set: its link's node-id, with - as :.

variantProperties.description: Its variant properties by their name in Figma, each with its values: { "Tone": ["Accent", "Neutral"] }. State, how it looks under the pointer, is one too.
